FN-XD5WC77-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 332
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Allen Treadaway
Security
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/02/2026
House Bill 332 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Department of Human
Resources (DHR), in consultation with the Alabama Department of Public Health (ADPH) and
the Alabama Board of Pharmacy, by an undetermined amount dependent on the cost to develop
an anaphylactic response policy to be utilized by licensed day care centers. Further, this bill
would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Department of Public Health to:
(1) select an entity to complete anaphylaxis training program to be used by employees of
licensed day care centers; and (2) develop a form to be used by the selected entity as a certificate
to show completion of the training.
